verdict.rationale: Appwrite's auth docs mention implementing MFA, so half the story has a thin first-party basis. Nothing in the pack shows enterprise SSO via SAML or OIDC; the 30+ social OAuth providers are consumer logins, not enterprise SSO. Missing for 10: enterprise SAML/OIDC SSO, a documented way to enforce (require) MFA for all users, in-depth MFA docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can require MFA and enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) for my application users

citations.quote: Implementing MFA to add extra layers of security to your app.
